third_party_evaluations.summary: Associate-level internal AD pentest exam; 2 days assessment + 2 days reporting.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded two-day assessment plus reporting demonstrates associate internal-testing delivery despite the foundational hint and zero-experience entry; junior scope and limited recognition prevent professional promotion.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The stored two-day internal AD assessment plus reporting provides associate delivery evidence despite zero experience and the foundational hint. Its junior scope and limited hiring recognition prevent treating it as a professional end-to-end engagement credential.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded two-day internal AD assessment plus two days of reporting demonstrate applied tasks beyond simple fundamentals. That supports associate placement above the foundational hint, while the junior scope and zero-experience profile prevent professional placement.
